colombia.title: Presidente Abelardo De La Espriella anuncia que alias Robinson Gutiérrez fue dado de baja: “Está implicado en el asesinato de Miguel Uribe Turbay”
colombia.title_en: President Abelardo De La Espriella announces that Robinson Gutiérrez, also known as “Robinson,” has been removed from his post: “He is implicated in the murder of Miguel Uribe Turbay.”

mundo.title: Trump cree que habrá un acuerdo con Cuba y que no será necesaria la intervención militar
mundo.title_en: Trump believes there will be an agreement with Cuba and that military intervention will not be necessary
